tournament.name: MTG China Open S2 Season Finals Cycle 2 RC

decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing powerful combo pieces to reanimate high impact creatures such as Sheoldred and Atraxa. By disrupting opponents with cards like Duress and Abrade, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Liliana of the Veil, the deck sets up its game-winning combo plays. The key strategy is to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures, then bring them back into play with cards like The Cruelty of Gix and Brotherhood's End to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's strategies while controlling the game with powerful creatures and removal spells. Using a mix of removal spells like Go for the Throat and Abrade, along with powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester, it aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition. Graveyard Trespasser and Corpse Appraiser also provide additional value by manipulating the graveyard. The deck's mana base ensures a consistent distribution of colors to cast its spells efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of removal spells, counter spells, and creatures with disruptive abilities. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining board presence and staying ahead in the resource game. It utilizes a mix of creature removal, artifact destruction, counterspells, and card draw to maintain control over the game state. The creatures in the deck provide additional utility and disruption, while the land base supports the overall game plan by providing the necessary mana sources to cast spells.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing control elements in order to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gradually building up a strong board presence with White creatures. The deck focuses on removal spells and enchantments, alongside powerful creatures like Steel Seraph and Serra Paragon to establish dominance on the battlefield. Additionally, the deck includes cards like The Restoration of Eiganjo and Field of Ruin to provide additional utility and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to control the game tempo and outvalue the opponent through strategic plays and card advantage.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature-based strategy, utilizing powerful creatures like Skrelv, Dennick, and Thalia to quickly overwhelm opponents. Raffine provides card advantage, while Adeline and Sheoldred offer additional threats. Control elements like Go for the Throat help deal with opposing threats. The mana base is focused on supporting the three-color deck, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands. The deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain board presence to secure victories.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on controlling the board with various removal spells and countermagic to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Reckoner Bankbuster to dominate the battlefield. The deck combines both creature removal and creature threats to maintain control and outvalue the opponent. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the color requirements of the deck, allowing for consistent casting of spells and creatures. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and overwhelm them with insurmountable advantage.

The deck focuses on removing and controlling opponent's threats through removal spells and board wipes, while generating card advantage with cards like Blue Sun's Twilight and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. It also aims to disrupt opponent's strategy with cards like Invoke Despair. The deck includes strong finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Collector to close out the game. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's color requirements and includes a mix of dual lands and basic lands to ensure consistency in casting spells.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through removal spells and hand disruption. It utilizes a combination of creature removal like Go for the Throat and Abrade, along with disruptive spells like Invoke Despair and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck also includes graveyard interaction with cards like Corpse Appraiser and Graveyard Trespasser. The goal of the deck is to control the board, disrupt the opponent's hand, and ultimately overpower them with powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By using cards like Reckoner Bankbuster and Lay Down Arms to control the board, and cards like Herd Migration and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to quickly build a strong board presence, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain that advantage throughout the game. Atraxa, Grand Unifier serves as a powerful finisher, while cards like Make Disappear and Leyline Binding help to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this Azorius Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively build a strong board presence using low-cost creatures such as Harbin, Vanguard Aviator, Recruitment Officer, and Valiant Veteran. These creatures can be protected and supported by cards like Protect the Negotiators and Resolute Reinforcements. The deck also includes some control elements with cards like Destroy Evil and Make Disappear to deal with threats. Additionally, the deck includes lands such as Adarkar Wastes and Seachrome Coast to ensure consistent mana production.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with creatures that have abilities that enhance their power and with spells that create advantageous board states. Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben work to pump up the team while Dennick, Pious Apprentice and Raffine, Scheming Seer provide card advantage. The deck also utilizes control elements with cards like Go for the Throat to deal with threats. The mana base is designed to provide flexibility and ensure smooth gameplay. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of creatures that provide additional benefits and disruption spells. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Go for the Throat to control the opponent's board. Mana fixing lands like Seachrome Coast and disruption lands like Shattered Sanctum help to ensure a smooth gameplay experience.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control over the game through removal spells and protection cards while building up a board presence with creatures that have powerful abilities. Cards like Ossification and Reckoner Bankbuster help to remove threats from the opponent's side of the battlefield, while cards like Sanctuary Warden and Serra Paragon provide protection and utility. The deck also includes land destruction cards like Field of Ruin to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the strategy revolves around maintaining control of the game until you can overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing combo pieces to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Atraxa, Grand Unifier while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Duress and Liliana of the Veil. It also includes removal spells like Abrade, Go for the Throat, and Cut Down to control the board. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong reanimation engine and powerful threats, while also having ways to protect its own creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan.
